lines.t: Before the stars were set in motion Before the tides obeyed the ocean
You were there in quiet flame Speaking life without a name
You stretch the sky with just a word
Every galaxy is heard
Mountains rise and oceans bow
Yet you're here beside me now
And all my striving fades away
When I remember who you are
The same hand that holds the night
Calls me into rest and light
You are greater than it all
Every star and every fall
Yeah, you meet me in the pause
In the stillness of it all
On a sacred quiet day
All my burdens drift away
In your presence I remain
Held inside unending grace
This time itself is in your hands, yet you tell my heart to stand
Not in labor, not in fear, but in knowing you are near
Every breath and every beat finds its rhythm at your feet
I don't have to chase the wind, you have always pulled me in
You are greater than it all, every rise and every fall
Yeah, you meet me in the past In the stillness of it all
On this holy set-apart day You restore what it faked away
I lay down my need to strive In your rest I come alive
The heavens echo, the earth replies
Your glory stretches through all time
And still you whisper, come be still
Beyond the noise, beyond my will
The infinite in quiet close
The one who holds me most
You are greater than it all
Endless faithful standing tall
Yeah, you meet me when I fall
In the stillness of it all
I'm a savage, I am free
From the weight of needing to be
You're everything I need
In your rest, my soul can breathe
Let the world keep spinning fast
I have found a peace that lasts
In the silence I can see
The one who made eternity
Is resting here with me
